name: Hefei SeeYa Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hefei SeeYa Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of OLEDoS displays. The company offers various OLEDoS displays, such as, 1.3", 1.03", 0.83", 0.72", 0.6", 0.49", and 0.32"; and OLEDoS optics solutions, such as Pancake, Lens group, Birdbath, and Waveguide. Its products are used in various industrial equipment, such as smart manufacturing, infrared thermal camera, medical equipment, education, simulation training, security, and services; as well as consumer usage, such as AR, VR, mobile viewing, mobile office, and EVF. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Hefei, China with an additional office in Shanghai, China.
